openQuestions: Source column for 4. 'Average value per payment': the legacy rule uses 'International payments average value per payment (ASB)'; the board also has 'Average value per payment (GHL Individual)' with the same four labels. Which column do advisers fill for GHL? (legacy kept).

'What do you intend to use your accounts for?' is multi-select on Monday but the PDF's two boxes are one checkbox field (one state only): selecting both is refused (MULTI_SELECT_NOT_REPRESENTABLE); the adviser must complete it by hand.
Expected differences from MacroForge in a parallel run: the three relabelled bands and section 5 are filled by the engine and left blank by MacroForge.
